scenes.text: We sent the archive out as a gift. A record of who we were, drifting toward anyone.
scenes.art_prompt: a golden disc drifting alone in deep black space with faint stars, cinematic

scenes.text: For forty years, nothing. Then one night the dish picked up a carrier wave on our own frequency.
scenes.art_prompt: a giant radio dish turned toward a starry sky, faint signal rings in the air

scenes.text: The signal carried the archive back. Every photograph, every greeting, every voice.
scenes.art_prompt: streams of glowing data returning toward a blue planet, long light trails

scenes.text: But the order had changed. The last message on the record was now the first one sent back.
scenes.art_prompt: rows of holographic image frames reversing order in the dark, eerie

scenes.text: We had sent a hello. Something out there read it to the end, then started over from the last line.
scenes.art_prompt: a lone listening station under a vast star field, quiet and unresolved

scenes.text: Follow Deep Space Logs for the next transmission.
scenes.art_prompt: a distant dish silhouetted against the Milky Way, final wide shot
